description: This file defines the `FlushNode` class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node responsible for flushing output buffers. It contains constructor and compile methods, and integrates with Twig's compiler and environment.

classes.name: FlushNode
classes.description: Represents a node that handles flushing output within Twig's compilation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of FlushNode with a specific line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for flushing the output buffer, optionally using 'yield' if enabled in the environment.
